findings.detail: The brief asks for five written picks in every sport. Four could not be built without inventing a number: Golf (the only captured PGA Tour leaderboard is the Butterfield Bermuda Championship, already in progress, so no pre-event field exists), Cricket (the ICC team-ranking pages captured are client-rendered shells with no ratings in the bytes, and no official results feed was captured to build a rating), Gaelic Sports (the GAA fixtures payload holds no match inside the 24 Oct – 8 Nov window; the county finals OLBG lists are not on gaa.ie) and Greyhounds (every GBGB racecard/fixture endpoint tried returned 404, and the OLBG hub lists a time but no runners). Each is stated on the Coverage page with its shortfall, and the OLBG events are listed with links instead of being published as rows.
